title: •Keder The Black
caption: •Keder The Black (V)
game_text: While at Senate: Sidious is politics +3; “senators” on Squabbling Delegates is treated as “Coruscant guards;” and may lose 1 Force to place Keder and an opponent’s {set:coruscant} Political Effect (or {set:coruscant} senator here) in owner’s Lost Pile.
lore: A highly paid assassin and *spy*, Keder has infiltrated the Senate disguised as a Coruscant Guard. The identity of his target and his employer remains a mystery to all but him.

notes: Group: Imperial Senate (DARK SIDE). Unique. Bottom-half slip. Stats POWER 4 / ABILITY 3 / FORCE-ATTUNED (label only) — same as printed; deploy 3 / forfeit 6 (printed 4 / 4). INLINE (twice): a round pink sphere with a yellow rim before 'Political Effect' and before 'senator' = the CORUSCANT expansion symbol → {set:coruscant} (the stub drops both). Curly double quotes “senators” and “Coruscant guards;” (stub straight single quotes), curly apostrophes opponent’s / owner’s. Icon column: warrior only. Affiliation Republic (Coruscant Dark frame, Republic crest disc; wiki subtype Republic). Printed card has the Coruscant ring + Episode I icon → ring_icons ['episode1']. LORE: 'spy' is printed BOLD on the scan (marked *spy*; 'assassin' plain). The punctuation after 'spy' is not resolvable on the 350 px scan (or the identical res.starwarsccg.org file) — the wiki's comma kept; please verify. Otherwise matches the wiki.
